prompt:
Create one finished Cars24 blog cover image, 1000 x 650 final crop-safe composition, dark Cars24 theme. This is a no-visible-text version: no headline, no body copy, no logo, no letters, no numbers, no UI text, no watermark anywhere.

Layout and optical balance: compose as a finished no-text key visual, not a title layout with text removed. The photo team cutout must be optically centred across the full canvas. Place the complete group as one balanced foreground mass centred around the horizontal midpoint of the canvas, with comparable breathing room on the left and right edges. Do not let the cutout, shoulders, hands, table, laptop, or white outline touch or crowd the right edge or left edge. Keep the subject fully inside the inner safe area with at least 7 percent canvas padding on both left and right. The group can be slightly lower-centre, but its visual centre should sit near the canvas centre. Use background pattern as atmosphere, not as an excuse for a lopsided hero.

Canvas: Cars24 Brand Blue #4736FE as the dominant full-bleed canvas, with a subtle same-hue vertical/ambient gradient for premium depth. The canvas must read as bright Cars24 brand blue: not navy, not indigo, not black, not midnight blue, not dark violet, not dimmed AI-tech mode. Do not render the hex code as text.

Pattern: restrained full-canvas Cars24 atmosphere. White luminous dot/wave fields, soft signal lines, small bokeh particles, and gentle operational flow curves move behind the team from lower-left through centre toward upper-right. Pattern should be visible on both sides of the hero so the image feels balanced. It must stay behind the photo cutout, never on top of people or laptop. No warning icons, no alert triangles, no dashboard cards, no readable labels.

Photo hero: real photographic cutout, not illustration. Show a calm Cars24 operations/service team of three South Asian professionals maximum, wearing clean blue Cars24-style polos or workwear, gathered around one laptop/tablet at a simple table, focused and composed. Natural skin tones, natural lighting, professional and reassuring expressions, not model-perfect. Render the team as a clean photographic cutout removed from its environment and placed directly on the Cars24 canvas, with a crisp visible white accent outline around the complete silhouette. Keep full heads, shoulders, hands, laptop/tablet, and table edge fully contained inside the safe zone; no cropping at edges.

Composition target: balanced editorial no-text visual. The hero is centred-lower with similar left/right margins, calm and stable. The background pattern fills the canvas evenly enough that no side feels empty or cramped.

Do not include: any visible text, any logo, dramatic disaster scene, crash, fire, panic, emergency imagery, storm, war room cliche, dense dashboard, readable fake UI text, scattered warning icons, stock-photo office background, rectangular photo frame, embedded photo panel, illustration style, marble/statue subject, watermark.
